fixes.explanation: That's the right call, baker. Paul never says these things discredit the ministry. He says, “…as servants of God we commend ourselves in every way…” and the beatings, imprisonments and hunger come inside that list (verses 4-5). It's a heavy stretch of verses. What the text says is that these are part of how they commend themselves.
Silence is a fair opposite for talk, baker, but it isn't in the verse. Paul writes, “…through glory and dishonor, slander and praise…” Slander pairs with praise. Silence isn't named in this pair.

True, baker! Verse 10 ends with, “having nothing, and yet possessing everything.” Nothing and everything in one breath. That's Paul's whole list landing at once. I spent years in the back of a junk drawer with next to nothing, and I wouldn't trade that line.
